sentences.text: Mussaurus is a genus of herbivorous sauropodomorph dinosaur.
The genus name Mussaurus means "mouse lizard" because early discoveries consisted only of small juvenile skeletons.
Juvenile Mussaurus were small quadrupedal herbivores that walked on all four legs.
Adult Mussaurus were medium-sized bipedal herbivores reaching up to 8 meters in length and weighing between 1.2 and 1.6 metric tons.
As of 2021, Mussaurus holds the record for the earliest unequivocal evidence of complex social behavior in dinosaurs, with over 100 eggs and 80 individuals found in one locality.
Mussaurus infant skeletons measured about 20 cm in length and weighed between 53.3 and 76.5 grams.
The discovery team found fossilized eggs and hatchlings, providing insight into the reproductive strategies of Mussaurus.
The first adult specimens of Mussaurus were formally described in 2013, though some were initially described in 1980 under the genus Plateosaurus.
Multiple specimens of different ages found together suggest Mussaurus lived in a gregarious lifestyle.
Mussaurus is estimated to have reached sexual maturity between 23 and 31 years of age and somatic maturity after 14 years.
Researchers initially reported evidence of medullary bone in a Mussaurus specimen in 2013, but later argued in 2014 that the tissue was likely pathological.
The genus Mussaurus belongs to the parent group Sauropodiformes.
Mussaurus is classified in the class Saurischia.
Mussaurus lived from 199.5 to 192.9 million years ago during the Sinemurian stage.
